description:
Hi! I'm a Computer Science student interested in software development, web technologies, AI/ML, game development, and space exploration. I'm participating in NASA Space Apps Challenge 2026 to build an innovative Junior Astronaut Mission Trainer.

I'm looking for passionate teammates skilled in game development, UI/UX design, 3D modeling, animation, space science, and storytelling. Let's collaborate, share ideas, and build an exciting space learning experience together!
